correctness.rationale: The exact affine-halfspace description is proved by reducing class totals to the hypersimplex \(\Delta_{2,s}\) and refining a class-pair decomposition to coordinate pairs. The intrinsic facet-normal norms are \(A=\sqrt{(n-1)/n}\) and \(B_j=\sqrt{h_j(n-h_j)/n}\). Ball containment is therefore equivalent to \(c_i\ge rA\) and \(c(C_j)\le1-rB_j\). Summation and single-class compatibility give the three upper bounds; interval feasibility gives a center attaining their minimum. The included high-precision checker independently re-solves the interval problem for every integer partition through \(n=24\).

value.rationale: The inradius is a canonical Euclidean roundness invariant for an entire classical family, not an arbitrary slice. The exact formula exposes three distinct obstruction mechanisms determined by the parallel-class sizes and also characterizes all optimal centers. This supplies geometric information not encoded by the known face/Ehrhart formulas and is plausibly useful when comparing or conditioning rank-two matroid base polytopes.
